name: zotero-modified
description: Unofficial Zotero 10 workflow tools for safe local curation, experimental native PDF annotations, Ethereal-compatible metadata, and citation styles.

interface.shortDescription: Zotero curation, PDF annotations, metadata, and CSL tools
interface.longDescription: An unofficial extension of the upstream OpenAI Zotero workflow, compatible with Ethereal Style metadata. It adds an up-front local-API authorization gate, one-confirmation multi-item curation, structured metadata updates, native colored tags, slash-prefixed statuses, Extra ratings, deduplication, local CSL installation, and experimental native PDF highlights and underlines through the companion Bridge. Dry-run previews and snapshots are produced only when requested.
defaultPrompt: create and curate a collection with one consolidated confirmation for multi-item writes
write statuses, ratings, roles, and controlled topical metadata following Ethereal Style conventions
write and install a CSL template for Zotero Word integration
highlight or underline an exact passage in the active Zotero PDF and convert selected annotations into a native note
